blurb: Carolina Ale House is a sports bar and restaurant featuring a scratch kitchen, a bar with local and national craft beer, and wall-to-wall big screens for watching sports. They offer private and semi-private event spaces for gatherings such as birthdays, company celebrations, reunions, and rehearsal dinners. The venue also has pool tables and a kids menu, with special kids night events.
extraNote: Open every day except Christmas Day; special hours on Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Day · Reservations accepted by calling the restaurant directly
